title: FairyLand
description:
“Throughout the land there are large, uninhabitable zones of extreme Mana saturation. These zones are known as “The FairyLand”. Non mana born creatures cannot survive within the FairyLand, nor can the denizens of the FairyLand survive when out of the FairyLand's grasp.”

To willingly enter the FairyLand means almost certain death. But to some, the fame and fortune are worth the risk.

 

Enter the FAIRYLAND

Search for teleport crystals, cash, and experience points as you explore the dungeon, fighting monsters, and the clock!

KEEP YOUR MANA LOW 

As you explore, you’ll begin absorbing the mana rich air of the fairyland. Although this sounds like a good thing, you aren’t a wizard, you can’t spend that mana without a magical artifact of some sort! So your only chance of avoiding death by mana-poisoning is to find a teleport crystal, and use it to drain some of that mana!!!

 

FEATURES:

- Procedural generation 

- Dungeon exploration 

- Combat

- RPG style leveling 

- High score 

- Timed levels
description_short: A casual endless dungeon crawler rogue-like RPG that tasks players with getting the highest score possible, as fast as possible.
